tei:bibl.tei:title: Winter, a hymn on "Immortality of the Soul" by Penina Moïse (Ḳ.Ḳ. Beth Elohim 1842)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Ḳahal Ḳadosh Beth Elohim
Penina Moïse
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: “Winter (Oh! sad is nature’s aspect now)” by Penina Moïse, published in 1842, appears under the subject “Winter” as Hymn 51 in Hymns Written for the Service of the Hebrew Congregation Beth Elohim, South Carolina (Penina Moïse et al., Ḳ.Ḳ. Beth Elohim, 1842), pp. 53-54. In the one copy of this first edition we know to exist, pages 53 through 56 are missing, and so the lines of the hymn were recovered from the second edition, Hymns Written for the Use of Hebrew Congregations (Penina Moïse et al., Ḳ.Ḳ. Beth Elohim, 1856), pp. 141-142, where it appears as Hymn 145. Punctuation and capitalization for these lines are provided as found under the conventions of the first edition. –Aharon Varady
